XenotypeDef.label: Whispers hybrid
XenotypeDef.description: An abandoned early-generation hybrid from Michael's experiments. Human captives were irreversibly altered with Iratus/Wraith and additional predatory traits. These creatures are blind, hunt by sound, and emit a predatory fog from neck gills.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A blind, sound-hunting early Michael hybrid that cloaks its approach in fog.
